arxiv-2002-08181.title: Interface Modeling for Quality and Resource Management \rsuper *
arxiv-2002-08181.creator: Martijn Hendriks \rsuper a,b, Marc Geilen \rsuper a, Kees Goossens \rsuper a, Rob de Jong \rsuper c, Twan Basten \rsuper a,b
arxiv-2002-08181.description: Abstract . We develop an interface-modeling framework for quality and resource management that captures configurable working points of hardware and software components in terms of functionality, resource usage and provision, and quality indicators such as performance and energy consumption. We base these aspects on partially-ordered sets to capture quality levels, budget sizes, and functional compatibility.

arxiv-2101-03498.title: Sum-Rate Maximization for UAV-assisted Visible Light Communications using NOMA: Swarm Intelligence meets Machine Learning
arxiv-2101-03498.creator: Quoc-Viet Pham, Thien Huynh-The, Mamoun Alazab, Jun Zhao, Won-Joo Hwang
arxiv-2101-03498.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Quoc-Viet Pham, Thien Huynh-The, Mamoun Alazab, Jun Zhao, Won-Joo Hwang. As the integration of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) into visible light communications (VLC) can offer many benefits for massive-connectivity applications and services in 5G and beyond, this work considers a UAV-assisted VLC using non-orthogonal multiple-access. More specifically, we formulate a joint problem of power allocation and UAV’s placement to maximize the sum rate of all users, subject to constraints on power allocation, quality of service of users, and UAV’s position.

arxiv-2106-01518.title: Dissecting Generation Modes for Abstractive Summarization Models via Ablation and Attribution
arxiv-2106-01518.creator: Jiacheng Xu and Greg Durrett
arxiv-2106-01518.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Jiacheng Xu and Greg Durrett. Despite the prominence of neural abstractive summarization models, we know little about how they actually form summaries and how to understand where their decisions come from. We propose a two-step method to interpret summarization model decisions.

arxiv-2206-09580.title: Dipper Donkin Quantized Matrix Algebra and Reflection Equation Algebra at root of unity
arxiv-2206-09580.creator: Snehashis Mukherjee 1 and Sanu Bera 2
arxiv-2206-09580.description: Abstract . In this article the quantized matrix algebras as in the title have been studied at a root of unity. A full classification of simple modules over such quantized matrix algebras of rank 2 2 along with a class of finite dimensional indecomposable modules are given. 2020 Mathematics Subject Classification 16D60, 16T20, 16S36, 16R20 1.

arxiv-2305-17138.title: Quantum gravity unchained: Atomic sensors as exotic field telescopes in multi-messenger astronomy
arxiv-2305-17138.creator: A. Derevianko
arxiv-2305-17138.description: Abstract We propose a novel, exotic physics, modality in multi-messenger astronomy. We are interested in a direct detection of exotic fields emitted by the mergers. This approach must be contrasted with the indirect detection strategies, e.g., based on minute exotic-physics induced changes in gravitational wave spectral features. While our strategy seems to be overly optimistic, the numbers do work out.

arxiv-2310-05364.title: Universal Multi-modal Entity Alignment via Iteratively Fusing Modality Similarity Paths CCS: Computing methodologies Knowledge representation and reasoning CCS: Computing methodologies Semantic networks
arxiv-2310-05364.creator: Bolin Zhu 1 , Xiaoze Liu 2 , Xin Mao 3 , Zhuo Chen 4 , Lingbing Guo 4 , Tao Gui 1 , Qi Zhang 1
arxiv-2310-05364.description: Abstract . The objective of Entity Alignment (EA) is to identify equivalent entity pairs from multiple Knowledge Graphs (KGs) and create a more comprehensive and unified KG. The majority of EA methods have primarily focused on the structural modality of KGs, lacking exploration of multi-modal information. A few multi-modal EA methods have made good attempts in this field.

arxiv-2405-10882.title: Binned angular analysis of B 0 → K ∗ 0 ​ μ + ​ μ − {{B}^{0}}\!\to{{K}^{*0}}{\mu^{+}}{\mu^{-}} with LHCb
arxiv-2405-10882.creator: Leon Carus, on behalf of the LHCb collaboration
arxiv-2405-10882.description: Abstract The analysis of b → s ​ ℓ ​ ℓ {b}\!\to{s}\ell\ell flavor-changing neutral current decays is a powerful test of the Standard Model (SM). Due to the strong suppression of these modes in the SM, potential New Physics contributions can have a significant impact on the measured physics observables.

arxiv-2407-15308.title: Cross section of the process 𝒆 + ​ 𝒆 − → 𝒏 ​ 𝒏 ¯ e^{+}e^{-}\to n\bar{n} near the threshold
arxiv-2407-15308.creator: M. N. Achasov, A. Yu. Barnyakov, E. V. Bedarev, K. I. Beloborodov, A. V. Berdyugin, A. G. Bogdanchikov, A. A. Botov, T. V. Dimova, V. P. Druzhinin, V. N. Zhabin, Yu. M. Zharinov, L. V. Kardapoltsev, A. S. Kasaev, A. A. Kattsin, D. P. Kovrizhin, A. A. Korol, A. S. Kupich, A. P. Kryukov, A. P. Lysenko
arxiv-2407-15308.description: Abstract The e + ​ e − → n ​ n ¯ e^{+}e^{-}\to n\bar{n} cross section was measured at center of mass (c.m.) energies from the threshold to 1908 MeV. The experiment to measure the cross section has been carried out at the VEPP-2000 e + ​ e − e^{+}e^{-} collider in 13 energy points.

arxiv-2503-09155.title: Instability of equilibrium and convergence to periodic orbits in strongly 2-cooperative systems
arxiv-2503-09155.creator: Rami Katz, Giulia Giordano, Michael Margaliot
arxiv-2503-09155.description: Abstract We consider time-invariant nonlinear n n -dimensional strongly 2 2 -cooperative systems, that is, systems that map the set of vectors with up to weak sign variation to its interior. Strongly 2 2 -cooperative systems enjoy a strong Poincaré-Bendixson property: bounded solutions that maintain a positive distance from the set of equilibria converge to a periodic solution.

arxiv-2508-15698.title: Connecting hypercube 1-factors
arxiv-2508-15698.creator: Lawrence Hollom, Benedict Randall Shaw
arxiv-2508-15698.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Lawrence Hollom, Benedict Randall Shaw. A 1-factorisation of a regular graph G G is a partition of its edge set E ⁡ ( G ) E(G) into perfect matchings of G G . Behague asked for the minimal r = r ⁡ ( d ) r=r(d) such that some 1 1 -factorisation of the d d -dimensional hypercube Q d Q_{d} has the property that the union of any r r of its 1-factors is connected.

arxiv-2510-10324.title: On some practical challenges of conformal prediction
arxiv-2510-10324.creator: Liang HongNoura Raydan Nasreddine
arxiv-2510-10324.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Liang HongNoura Raydan Nasreddine. Conformal prediction is a model-free machine learning method for creating prediction regions with a guaranteed coverage probability level. However, a data scientist often faces three challenges in practice: (i) the determination of a conformal prediction region is only approximate, jeopardizing the finite-sample validity of prediction, (ii) the computation required could be prohibitively expensive, and (iii) the shape of a conformal prediction region is hard to control.

catholic-encyclopedia-1913-zamora.description: Article 'Zamora' from the Catholic Encyclopedia (1913), the 15-volume English-language reference work published 1907-1914 by Robert Appleton Company.

pmc-11364145.title: An increasing number of states filled Conrad 30 waivers for recruiting international medical graduates
pmc-11364145.creator: Tarun Ramesh, Sarah E Brotherton, Gregory D Wozniak, Hao Yu
pmc-11364145.description: To address physician shortages in the United States, Congress created the Conrad 30 visa waiver program allowing non-citizen international medical graduates to obtain visas to practice medicine in underserved areas. There is little information on whether states have effectively used the program. To fill the gap, we examined the growth and distribution of Conrad physicians between 2001 and 2020.

pmc-11839322.title: Correlating clinical course with subcortical shape in provisional tic disorder
pmc-11839322.creator: Tiffanie Che, Soyoung Kim, Deanna J Greene, Ashley Heywood, Jimin Ding, Tamara Hershey, Bradley L Schlaggar, Kevin J Black, Lei Wang
pmc-11839322.description: Objective.This study examined children at the onset of tic disorder (tics for less than 9 months: NT group), a population on which little research exists. Here, we investigate relationships between the baseline shape and volume of subcortical nuclei, diagnosis, and tic symptom outcomes.Methods.

pmc-12966788.title: Complex soft tissue and facial bone reconstruction after a bear attack in Indonesia: a case report of definitive management following an 8-hour interfacility transfer
pmc-12966788.creator: Amira Azra Arisa Putri, Mufida Muzakkie
pmc-12966788.description: Bear attacks, although rare, may result in severe maxillofacial trauma, highlighting the devastating consequences of human-wildlife conflict in rural areas. Bear maulings typically cause cutting, penetrating, and crushing injuries, with most victims sustaining contaminated maxillofacial trauma requiring comprehensive management to prevent complications.

pmc-13249714.title: Deep learning-based histopathological classification and subclassification of benign and malignant salivary gland tumors
pmc-13249714.creator: Andreas Weber, Daniel Schuster, Jannis Heyer, Christoph Becker, Valentin Burkhardt, Martin Werner, Andreas Spörlein, Peter Bronsert, Tobias Schulz
pmc-13249714.description: BackgroundSalivary gland tumors are rare and histopathologically diverse, presenting a diagnostic challenge. Accurate diagnosis is essential for optimal treatment planning. This study evaluates deep learning models in distinguishing benign from malignant salivary gland tumors using hematoxylin and eosin-stained histopathological images.

pmc-13366769.title: Diagnostic performance of saline-aided ultrasound in the detection of colorectal polyps in children
pmc-13366769.creator: Tong Wang, Haiying Zhou, Tingting Ding, Jia Li, Liezhen Hu, Wei Yu, Meixi Chen, Zhou Lin, Jinlong Deng, Luyao Zhou
pmc-13366769.description: ObjectivesThis study aimed to evaluate the diagnostic performance of saline-aided gastroenteric ultrasound (US) for detecting colorectal polyps in pediatric patients.MethodsIn this single-center, retrospective study (April 2018 to November 2023), we analyzed 466 patients with suspected colorectal polyps. All patients underwent conventional US followed by diagnostic colonoscopy.

pmc-13583568.title: Clinically actionable genomic alterations in breast cancer brain metastases
pmc-13583568.creator: G. Griguolo, A. Collesei, E. Lazzarini, M. Bottosso, M.V. Dieci, S. Fineberg, L. Bauchet, G. Landa, F. Miglietta, J. Jacob, V. Rigau, M. La Commare, L. Trovò, M. Fassan, W. Jacot, A.P. Dei Tos, S. Indraccolo, A. Darlix, V. Guarneri
pmc-13583568.description: BackgroundBreast cancer brain metastases (BCBMs) represent a critical unmet clinical need in metastatic breast cancer (MBC) and the identification of novel therapeutic targets is urgently needed in this context. In this study, we describe clinically actionable targets in BCBMs using comprehensive genomic profiling.
